published_reduced_example.note: Keep the published inputs as printed. The arithmetic mean of the two raw Sun altitudes is 51:58.5, not the printed 51:58. Do not silently change either dataset.

observations.instrument: Davis Mark III; artificial horizon; raw measured angles are doubled altitudes
limitations: No independent precise observing position is specified in this example; 59N 18E is the iteration seed.
Graduation calibration is imported from calibration.py and must be resolved at a consistent source revision.
The second sight omits its limb argument; do not invent an observed limb from a software default.
Pressure and temperature are omitted; library defaults are not measured weather.
The chronometer object is defined but its use is commented out.
These readings are on different days, not one watch. Ordinary altitude/fix extraction is not included in the first Sun-Moon lab.

reference_policy.rationale: Predeclared comparison budgets, not sextant uncertainties. Horizons apparent RA/Dec uses EOP-corrected IAU76/80 (approximately 53 mas equinox offset from IAU06/00a); the baseline uses ERFA IAU06/00a. Topocentric budget also accommodates omitted DUT1, polar motion and diurnal aberration for these dated cases. Failures must be investigated, not automatically retoleranced.
reference_policy.limits: Horizons currently reports DE441 while the baseline uses DE440s: this is an independent implementation check, not wholly independent underlying ephemeris data. It does not certify atmospheric refraction, lunar limb topography or physical local vertical.
